```git-sandbox
id: plain
title: A box without VS Code
prompt: "~/sales-analysis $"
seed: |
  git init
  echo "# Sales analysis" > README.md
  git add .
  git commit -m "Add the README"
```

::: {style="height: 1600px"}
Room enough that the exercises below start out of view.
:::

```git-sandbox-vscode
id: in-vscode
title: Commit from VS Code
prompt: "~/sales-analysis $"
intro: |
  Stage {y}analysis.R{/}, then commit it.
seed: |
  git init
  echo "# Sales analysis" > README.md
  git add .
  git commit -m "Add the README"
  echo "x <- 1" > analysis.R
tasks:
  - text: Stage `analysis.R`
    when: staged
  - text: Commit it
    when: commits >= 2
```

::: {style="height: 1600px"}
:::

```git-sandbox-vscode
id: shared
title: The plain box, in VS Code
share: plain
tasks:
  - text: Create a branch called `feature`
    when: branch feature
```
